title: Vickers Wellington NZ-N
memorial_details: description: HERE ON 27/28 MAY 1941 / A WELLINGTON BOMBER / NZ-N OF 304 POLISH SQUADRON / CRASHED AFTER BOMBING THE FRENCH / PORT OF BOLOGNE WHERE IT HAD BEEN / HIT AND BADLY DAMAGED / CREW WHO DIED / (3 NAMES) / (1 NAME) / DROWNED IN THE LA MANCHE CANAL / CREW WHO SURVIVED / (2 NAMES) / BALED OUT
inscription: HERE ON 27/28 MAY 1941 / A WELLINGTON BOMBER / NZ-N OF 304 POLISH SQUADRON / CRASHED AFTER BOMBING THE FRENCH / PORT OF BOLOGNE WHERE IT HAD BEEN / HIT AND BADLY DAMAGED / CREW WHO DIED / (3 NAMES) / (1 NAME) / DROWNED IN THE LA MANCHE CANAL / CREW WHO SURVIVED / (2 NAMES) / BALED OUT
